correctness.rationale: Write X=A+epsilon B. The square-zero equation is exactly A²=0, AB+BA=0, including characteristic 2. In image/complement/kernel basis of A of field rank r, the anticommutator has full block solution B=[P Q L;0 -P 0;0 M T], with s=n-2r, and all blocks independent. Smith elimination on r unit pivots leaves epsilon*T and zeros, so t=rank T. Prescribed-image/kernel flag counting gives [n r]_q[n-r r]_q GL_r residue choices; free dual-block count q^(2r(n-r)) times the exact rank-t s-by-s field matrix count. Summing t gives q^(n^2) prod_{j=s+1}^n(1-q^-j)/Phi_r. Uniform bulk convergence to 1/Phi_infty with summable boundary error O(q^-r+q^-s) proves flat rank, total coefficient and conditional Gaussian-field corank law. The corank tails satisfy a q^-d² bound, allowing joint weak convergence and independence; n=1, r=0, t=0/1 cases correct. Independent ambient A,B enumeration checked q=2 n=1,2,3; q=3 n=2; q=5 n=2 and every joint Smith stratum, plus exact marginal identities q=2,3,4,5,7 n<=23. These finite tests are not substituted for the asymptotic proof.

final_claim: Over F_q[epsilon]/(epsilon^2) for any prime power q and n>=1, the joint number of square-zero n-by-n matrices with residue rank r and exactly t epsilon-type Smith entries is [n r]_q[n-r r]_q |GL_r| q^(2r(n-r)) [n-2r t]_q^2 |GL_t|. Total is q^(n^2)(n/(2 Phi_infty(q))+O_q(1)); scaled residue rank tends uniformly to [0,1/2] and independently the Smith deficiency has mass q^(-d^2)Phi_infty/Phi_d^2.
limitations: Equal-characteristic dual-number ring only; no similarity classification, mixed characteristic Z/p², or higher nilpotency exponent. Historical exact finite-ring enumeration requires further primary reading.
